items.title: Khaki Knitting Book

items.title: The Mary Frances Knitting and Crocheting Book
items.blurb: A 1918 instruction book for knitting and crocheting. About 270 printed pages, so it is a large download.

items.title: The Knitting Book (3rd edition)
items.author: Eléonore Riego de la Branchardière
items.blurb: Victorian-era knitting terms and patterns: berthes, collars, lace edgings, a baby's cap and more. Gutenberg offers HTML/EPUB, not PDF; print the page to PDF to import it.
items.rights: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg.

items.title: Knitting: How to Knit and What to Knit

items.blurb: A short illustrated how-to covering stockings and other in-the-round knitting. Gutenberg offers HTML/EPUB, not PDF.
items.rights: Public domain in the USA per Project Gutenberg.

items.title: Illustrated Instruction Book for the Bickford Family Knitting Machine
items.author: D. Bickford
items.blurb: Operating instructions for a 19th-century home knitting machine. 59 printed pages.
items.source: Library of Congress via Internet Archive
